title: Romantic Singapore with Night Safari and Sentosa
alt: Gardens by the Bay Supertrees glowing above the Marina Bay skyline in Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Couples get the best of the city here. Wildlife after dark, the skyline from 57 floors up and a whole day on Sentosa.
expert.tip: Book the SkyPark slot before sunset and stay up there as the lights come on over Marina Bay. It is the one view everyone talks about afterwards.

summary: Five days in Singapore for two. Wildlife by tram on the first night, the city and Marina Bay on day two, a full day at Universal Studios, then Sentosa with the cable car, the oceanarium and the Wings of Time show on the beach.
included: Included: 4 nights at the Aqueen Prestige Lavender with daily breakfast; Night Safari with tram ride; half day city tour; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; Gardens by the Bay with Cloud Forest, Flower Dome and Jurassic World; Universal Studios one day pass; two way cable car sky pass; Singapore Oceanarium; Wings of Time; 9 private and shared transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; rides and games not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: City tour, SkyPark and the Gardens
day_titles.4: Sentosa, oceanarium and Wings of Time

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to your hotel in Lavender
Check in and rest for a few hours before the evening out
Shared transfer to Mandai for the Night Safari with a tram ride through the park
Leopards, lions and tapirs are awake at this hour, which is the whole point
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the colonial civic district
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark on level 57 for the view across the bay
Cloud Forest, Flower Dome and Jurassic World at Gardens by the Bay
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios with all seven themed zones
Battlestar Galactica, Transformers and the Mummy ride for the brave
Evening free for dinner in Chinatown or along Clarke Quay
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass across the harbour with Sentosa below you
Singapore Oceanarium with its open ocean tank and reef habitats
Wings of Time on Siloso beach after dark, water, fire and light
5: Breakfast and a relaxed check out
Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Aqueen Prestige Lavender, four minutes on foot from Lavender MRT

program.name: City nights and an island day
program.description: Four nights in Lavender with the MRT at the door, a wildlife evening at Mandai, the Marina Bay skyline and a full day on Sentosa.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: The world's first wildlife park built for after dark, with a tram circuit past the Asian elephants, hyenas and the big cats.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach run past Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the civic district buildings.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The observation deck on level 57 of Marina Bay Sands, straight above the bay, the Gardens and the city towers.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Cloud Forest with its indoor waterfall, the Flower Dome and the Jurassic World walk among the Supertrees.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A one day pass for the Sentosa park, from Sci Fi City and Ancient Egypt to the Hollywood boulevard shows.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way ride between Mount Faber, HarbourFront and Sentosa with the working harbour under your feet.

activities.name: Singapore Oceanarium
activities.description: The rebuilt Sentosa aquarium with an open ocean tank, reef habitats and a research gallery for the children.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: An open air night show on Siloso beach built from water jets, lasers, fire and a short story on screen.

activities.name: Singapore River Cruise
activities.description: A bumboat along the quays past the shophouses and the old bridges, best taken once the lights are on.
